subject: Film & Cinema
title: Studio Ghibli: Japan's Animation Soul
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Studio Ghibli: Japan's Animation Soul.

hook.text: Miyazaki draws flying machines, forest spirits, and children who face fear without superpowers.

buildup.text: Studio Ghibli — founded in 1985 — produces hand-drawn films that treat animation as fine art.

discovery.text: Spirited Away won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature, proving Ghibli's global reach.

twist.text: Miyazaki has 'retired' multiple times but keeps returning because the stories demand telling.

climax.text: Ghibli proved animation doesn't need action or jokes — beauty and wonder are enough.

punchline.text: He draws worlds you wish you could visit.

quiz.question: What Ghibli film won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature?
